Compared to the nanoscale sizes and the polygonal shapes of the raw TiC nanoparticles (see Fig. 1 b), the submicron sizes and the dendritic shapes of the TiC particles in the DED samples sug- gest a dissolution-precipitation mechanism of the TiC formation.
